The Most Holy Name of Mary

subject.name: The Most Holy Name of Mary
subject.subtitle: Optional Memorial, September 12
subject.blurb: A feast of the name of the Blessed Virgin, kept on the octave day of her Nativity. Extended to the universal calendar by Innocent XI in 1684 in thanksgiving for the lifting of the siege of Vienna the previous year, it was dropped from the calendar in 1969 and restored by John Paul II in 2002.
subject.notification: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us!
